gaps.sentence: In my opinion, that restaurant is ___ — the food is nothing special (RATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Nothing special' shows the restaurant is praised too much: overrated (over- + rated).

gaps.sentence: After the long journey, we were all ___ (EXHAUST).
gaps.explanation: People who experience the feeling take -ed: we were exhausted. The journey was exhausting.

gaps.sentence: He ___ denied knowing anything about the plan (FIRM).
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'denied': firmly. Note the doubled m before -ly.
The suffix -en forms verbs from adjectives: thicken. A base verb follows 'to'.
'Beyond recognition' is the fixed phrase; after 'beyond' a noun is needed.

gaps.sentence: New technology has ___ the way we work (REVOLUTION).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: revolutionise. After 'has' the past participle 'revolutionised' is needed.

gaps.hint: noun needed after 'His'; note the -al suffix
gaps.explanation: The noun of 'refuse' is 'refusal' (-al noun); 'refuse' as a noun means rubbish.

gaps.sentence: There was a lot of ___ (OPPOSE) to the new road.
gaps.explanation: 'A lot of' needs a noun: opposition (-tion noun); 'opposite' is an adjective or noun meaning the contrary.
